kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تعاقبت (form VI)
# تَعَاقَبْتُ (taʕāqabtu) /ta.ʕaː.qab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
# تَعَاقَبْتَ (taʕāqabta) /ta.ʕaː.qab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
# تَعَاقَبْتِ (taʕāqabti) /ta.ʕaː.qab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
# تَعَاقَبَتْ (taʕāqabat) /ta.ʕaː.qa.bat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
